verses.text: Now di feast of unleavened bread, wey dem call Passover, dey near.
Di chief priests and di scribes dey look for how dem go kill am, because dem fear di people.
Satan enter Judas wey dem dey call Iscariot, wey be one of di 12.
E go talk with di chief priests and captains about how e go deliver am to dem.
Dem glad, and agree to give am money.
E agree, and dey look for chance to deliver am to dem when crowd no dey.
Di day of unleavened bread reach, wey dem must sacrifice di Passover.
E send Peter and John, dey talk say, “Go prepare di Passover for us, make we chop.”
Dem talk to am say, “Wia you want make we prepare?”
E talk to dem say, “Look, when una don enter di city, one man wey carry pitcher of water go meet una. Follow am enter di house wey e enter.
Tell oga of di house, ‘Di Teacher talk to you say, Wia di guest room dey, wia I go chop di Passover with my disciples?’
E go show una one big upper room wey dem don arrange. Prepare there.”
Dem go, find things as e tell dem, and dem prepare di Passover.
When di hour reach, e sit down with di 12 apostles.
E talk to dem say, “I don want strongly to chop this Passover with una before I suffer,
because I dey tell una, I no go chop am again until e fulfill for God Kingdom.”
E receive cup, and when e don thank God, e talk say, “Take this, share am among yourselves,
because I dey tell una say I no go drink from di fruit of di vine again, until God Kingdom come.”
E take bread, and when e don thank God, e break am, give dem, dey talk say, “This na my body wey dem give for una. Do this to remember me.”
Na so too di cup after supper, dey talk say, “This cup na di new covenant for my blood, wey dem pour out for una.
But look, di hand of di one wey dey betray me dey with me for di table.
Because di Son of Man dey go, as dem don decide, but sorrow dey for that man wey dem go use betray am!”
Dem begin ask each other, which of dem go do this thing.
Argument rise among dem too, which of dem dem consider to be greatest.
E talk to dem say, “Di kings of di nations dey rule dem hard, and di people wey get authority over dem dem dey call ‘benefactors.’
But no be so for una. But di one wey greater among una, make e become like di youngest, and di one wey dey lead like di one wey dey serve.
Because who greater, di one wey dey sit for table, or di one wey dey serve? No be di one wey dey sit for table? But I dey among una as di one wey dey serve.
But una na di ones wey stay with me for my trials.
I dey give una kingdom, just as my Papa God give me,
so that una go chop and drink for my table for my Kingdom. Una go sit for thrones dey judge di 12 tribes of Israel.
Simon, Simon, look, Satan ask to get una, so that e go sift una like wheat,
but I pray for you, so that your faith no go fail. You, when you don turn back, strengthen your brothers.”
E talk to am say, “Lord, I ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”
E talk say, “I dey tell you, Peter, cock no go crow today until you deny three times say you know me.”
E talk to dem say, “When I send una out without purse, bag, and sandals, una lack anything?” Dem talk say, “Nothing.”
Den e talk to dem say, “But now, anybody wey get purse, make e take am, and bag too. Anybody wey no get, make e sell im cloak, buy sword.
Because I dey tell una say this wey dem write must still fulfill for me: ‘Dem count am among transgressors.’ Because wetin concern me get end.”
Dem talk say, “Lord, look, two swords dey here.” E talk to dem say, “E don enough.”
E come out, go, as e dey do, go di Mount of Olives. Im disciples follow am too.
When e reach di place, e talk to dem say, “Pray say una no go enter temptation.”
E go from dem about stone throw, e kneel down pray,
dey talk say, “Papa God, if you willing, remove this cup from me. But no be my will, but your own make e happen.”
One angel from heaven appear to am, dey strengthen am.
As e dey for agony, e pray more strongly. Im sweat become like big drops of blood dey fall down for ground.
When e get up from im prayer, e come to di disciples, find dem dey sleep because of sorrow,
and talk to dem say, “Why una dey sleep? Get up, pray so that una no go enter temptation.”
As e still dey talk, look, crowd come, and di one wey dem dey call Judas, one of di 12, dey lead dem. E near Jesus to kiss am.
But Jesus talk to am say, “Judas, na with kiss you dey betray di Son of Man?”
When di people wey dey around am see wetin dey about to happen, dem talk to am say, “Lord, make we strike with sword?”
One of dem strike di servant of di high priest, cut im right ear.
But Jesus answer, “Make e reach here”—and e touch im ear, heal am.
Jesus talk to di chief priests, captains of di temple, and elders, wey come against am, “Una come out like say na against robber, with swords and clubs?
When I dey with una for di temple every day, una no stretch out una hands against me. But this na una hour, and di power of darkness.”
Dem catch am, lead am go, bring am enter di high priest house. But Peter follow from far.
When dem don light fire for di middle of di courtyard, and sit down together, Peter sit among dem.
One servant girl see am as e sit for di light, look am well, talk say, “This man dey with am too.”
E deny Jesus, talk say, “Woman, I no know am.”
After small time another person see am, talk say, “You na one of dem too!” But Peter answer, “Man, no be me!”
After about one hour, another person talk strongly say, “Truly this man dey with am too, because e be Galilean!”
But Peter talk say, “Man, I no know wetin you dey talk!” At once, as e still dey talk, cock crow.
Lord turn, look Peter. Den Peter remember di Lord word, how e talk to am say, “Before cock crow today, you go deny me three times.”
E go out, cry bitterly.
Di men wey hold Jesus mock am and beat am.
As dem don cover im eyes, dem hit am for face, ask am say, “Prophesy! Who be di one wey hit you?”
Dem talk plenty other things against am, dey insult am.
As soon as day break, di assembly of di elders of di people gather together, both chief priests and scribes, and dem lead am go dem council, dey talk say,
“If you na Christ, tell us.” But e talk to dem say, “If I tell una, una no go believe,
and if I ask, una no go answer me or let me go.
From now, di Son of Man go sit for di right hand of di power of God.”
Dem all talk say, “So you na God Pikin?” E talk to dem say, “Una talk am say I be.”
Dem talk say, “Why we still need more witnesses? Because we don hear am ourselves from im own mouth!”
